title: Prove the sharp four-drop cut for two six-dimensional P104 depositors
body:
In the specified 9-gatherer/8-depositor profile, two 6D depositor inputs force at least four outside drops. Reducing to first depositor contacts gives D ≥ 56 + E + B even with rational coefficients and arbitrary depositor relays. Exact arrangements attain D = 56 and D = 57 with one relay.

## Scope and source

The pinned NET-D56 predecessors and the single-depot contraction are cited in the archive. The sole-6D case separately gives two outside drops. DreamingOfClouds’ Q=0 and thin toolkit extension is #7869 at `06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956`. The archive identifies additional inputs by exact commit, path and hash. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; P104 toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-net56-two-six-depots/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory. Check its inner checksum manifest. The portable README records the exact commands and clean replay, including the independent paper audit and the rational equality and relay fixtures. The archive preserves the verification evidence and controls. This is an offline research archive; hosted package execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Extend the cut to less restricted gatherer and depositor profiles. The legal-word realization bridge and Lean formalization remain open.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. Related results: [P104 campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
